name: Ulgrotha
description: A small backwater plane far from Dominaria, rich in mana, devastated by the Apocalypse Chime, setting of the Homelands expansion.

description_citations.text: "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As Feroz's Ban begins to fail, the Autumn Willow feels her sustaining energies fade and agonizes over restarting the plane's mana channels at the cost of all creatures in the Homelands.
timeline.quote: When Feroz's Ban started to fail, she felt the energies that sustained her begin to fade.

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The spell makes Eron immortal and immune to aging.
timeline.quote: Eron discovered he was immortal and immune to aging.

citation.text: "Eron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir finds out Bernatheen and twists him into a greater werewolf as punishment.
timeline.quote: Bernatheen was later found out by Baron Sengir and twisted into a greater werewolf as punishment.

citation.text: "Eron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Autumn Willow creates the faerie noble Veldrane of Sengir, and the nobles take over the River Bridge in the Great Wood.
timeline.quote: The Autumn Willow created one of them in the form of Veldrane of Sengir .

citation.text: "Faerie", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eron the Relentless steals a magical tome from Castle Sengir for Bernatheen, gains immortality, and rises to become King of Ulgrotha's Goblins.
timeline.quote: the Human thief Eron gained immortality after stealing a magical tome from Castle Sengir for the wizard Bernatheen

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "The Man Who Would Be King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz isolates Ulgrotha, giving Autumn Willow sentience; later Feroz's Ban fails and she tries to save the folk of An-Havva from Baron Sengir.
timeline.quote: gained sentience after the planeswalker Feroz isolated the plane of Ulgrotha from the rest of the Multiverse

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "Caretaker of the Wood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz comes across Ulgrotha, a plane ruined by the Wizards' Wars.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Feroz came across Ulgrotha , the once-beautiful plane now destroyed by the Wizards' Wars .

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the last unspoiled oasis Feroz meets and marries Serra; together they work to restore the plane and create Feroz's Ban.
timeline.quote: he met fellow planeswalker Serra , whom he married.

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz dies in a lab accident and the grief-stricken Serra abandons the plane.
timeline.quote: Later, Feroz died during a lab accident, and the grief-stricken Serra abandoned the plane.

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Serra gone, civilizations fight each other while Baron Sengir plots to take control under the fading Ban.
timeline.quote: the vampire Baron Sengir plots to take control of the plane under the fading Ban of Feroz.

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac sees a vampire army reluctantly led by Ihsan around 4500 AR.
timeline.quote: he saw a great army of vampires, reluctantly led by a giant in armor

citation.text: "Ihsan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir attacked the returning Sandruu and defeated him.
timeline.quote: Taysir defeated Sandruu but was then attacked by a friend of the exiled planeswalker, Feroz .

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Anaba Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir enslaved the Anaba and summoned an earthquake against Feroz, killing many Anaba and destroying the pictoglyph caves.
timeline.quote: Taysir enslaved the Anaba, and many of them were killed when Taysir summoned an earthquake against Feroz, which also destroyed the pictoglyph caves.

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Anaba Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz killed Taysir; the Spiritcrafters preserved his body and revived him as an ally two centuries later.
timeline.quote: Feroz eventually killed Taysir, but the Spiritcrafters preserved his body and spent two centuries calming his soul, reviving him as a kind and humble ally.

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Anaba Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the peak of the Great War on Ulgrotha, Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, destroying both parties and causing the Great Destruction.
timeline.quote: Ravi rang the chime and destroyed both parties, resulting in the Great Destruction that formed the Dead Zone

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The vampire Baron Sengir frees Ravi, neither recognizing the other, and takes her to his castle as Grandmother Sengir and his tutor.
timeline.quote: she was freed by her childhood friend, the Baron Sengir , now a full-fledged vampire

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the eve of the Mending, Sengir and Ihsan leave Ulgrotha at the head of a vampire army; Ravi stays and later defends Ulgrotha in the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Grandmother Sengir stayed behind on Ulgrotha, and participated in the plane's defense during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Centuries later Sengir is summoned during a planeswalker duel and stranded on Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: Centuries later, Baron Sengir was summoned during a planeswalker duel on Ulgrotha.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sengir turns Lord Ihsan into a shade and servant instead of a vampire.
timeline.quote: he made him into a shade and faithful servant.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In BOOM! Comics, Sorin Markov binds Sengir in a pocket dimension with obelisks.
timeline.quote: so he erected obelisks in the dwarven city and bound him in a pocket dimension, along with the dwarven vampires.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "BOOM! Comics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra falls in love with Feroz and lives with him on Ulgrotha until he is accidentally killed.
timeline.quote: Feroz himself was accidentally killed before her eyes

citation.text: "Serra", section "Living with Feroz on Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra inquisitors raid the Death Speakers' homes, while Baron Sengir offers them black magic books to win control of them.
timeline.quote: which caused Serra inquisitors to raid their homes

citation.text: "Speaker", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir attacks Sandruu, banishes him to a remote plane, and is killed by Feroz on Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: killed him by splitting his skull with a broadsword.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "First death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Over two centuries the Anaba Ancestors redeem Taysir's spirit and he returns in a withered body, taking Daria as apprentice.
timeline.quote: On Ulgrotha he found a young native planeswalker, Daria , and took her as his apprentice and as his foster daughter.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "The Planeswalkers War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Tolgath and the Ancients wage war on Ulgrotha, and one of the Ancients opens a rift to another world to fuel spells.
timeline.quote: one of the Ancients was forced to open a rift from Ulgrotha to a different world, just to fuel their spells

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Tolgath Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, ending the war and devastating the whole plane.
timeline.quote: the Tolgath Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Chime kills all creatures, and the land becomes the Dead Zone that drains mana and life; Ravi hides in a coffin and cannot free herself.
timeline.quote: All creatures perished

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dwarves from another plane dig through a planar gate to Ulgrotha and found New Freedom and the castle Morning Light.
timeline.quote: a colony of Dwarves from another plane dug through a subterranean planar gate to Ulgrotha

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir frees the mad Ravi from her coffin and renames her Grandmother Sengir.
timeline.quote: He freed her from the coffin, and brought her with him, renaming her Grandmother Sengir.

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra arrives, encourages peace among the nomads and founds Aysen, becoming its protector goddess.
timeline.quote: she encouraged peace between the various plains nomads and the foundation of the state of Aysen

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz arrives and falls in love with Serra; Baron Sengir moves against them; Feroz founds the Wizards' School.
timeline.quote: with whom he quickly fell in love

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir follows Sandruu to Ulgrotha, defeats and exiles him, and is then defeated by Feroz.
timeline.quote: Their duel was won by Taysir, who exiles Sandruu to a remote plane.

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz and Serra cast a magical barrier over the world to guard it from planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: decided to cast a magical barrier over the world to guard it against further despoilment at the hands of strangers

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz dies in a laboratory accident and Serra is manipulated by Sengir into leaving the plane; the ban begins to fail.
timeline.quote: Feroz tragically died in a laboratory accident, and Serra was manipulated by Sengir to leave the plane in sadness and guilt

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac visits around 4500 AR and sees a vampire army under Ihsan's Shade, hinting at Sengir's conquest.
timeline.quote: Leshrac saw a vampire army marching in the night at the reluctant command of Ihsan 's Shade

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grandmother Sengir stays behind to defend the plane when Ulgrotha becomes a target of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Grandmother Sengir stayed behind and was part of the planes' defense

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ulgrotha Baron Sengir punishes a corrupt wizard savant by making him the first greater werewolf.
timeline.quote: was made into the first greater werewolf as punishment by Baron Sengir

citation.text: "Werewolf", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: then rose to become the King of Ulgrotha 's Goblins

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "The Man Who Would Be King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: R&D discussed whether Innistrad was supposed to be Ulgrotha many years later, but decided against a callback.
relations.quote: R&D talked about if Innistrad was supposed to be Ulgrotha many years later

citation.text: "Innistrad/Trivia", section "Various". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
